caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate container with a lid, rendered entirely in shades of green. The container is hexagonal in shape with a wide base that tapers inward before expanding outward at the top. The lid is dome-like with a small, faceted knob at the peak. Both the base and lid are decorated with intricate patterns that include arched, window-like designs and a combination of vertical and crisscrossed lines, bordered by small dotted details. The container stands on a circular pedestal that is slightly wider than its stem. The background is plain, and the object is centered within a rectangular border. The artist's signature, "G. Capelli," appears in the lower left corner outside the main image border.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
